actions.title: Run scripts/release.ps1, or at minimum commit the touched files with an explicit path list, before another session stacks a sixth uncommitted patch on top.
Land steps two through four of the measurement plan in the enemy field and attach a flow-field navigation before the crowd path is considered for default-on.
Exclude the bridge plugin from release exports, or gate its server start behind an editor-only check, before the next milestone moves toward a shippable build.
Rule the eight campaign decisions and record them in the design document before more work lands on the mission data layer.
Confirm which script is wired into the editor build, delete the other, and keep one foundation-path dictionary.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Rewrite that paragraph to summarise the measurement and state which steps are done and which remain.
Wire the remap into the damage numbers, scope tags and status bar, or grey out the dropdown until it is wired.
Have the notifier's catch block write a one-line failure marker somewhere durable, mirroring the digest poster's exit-path status.
Rewrite that line to name the current pipeline for the three-dimensional work and scope the earlier credit to the menu and branding art.
Move the integrity confirmation out of the rebase-only branch so it runs after every push attempt.
Give the publish script the same recovery path the integrity checker has, or document why they differ, and post a failure notice before the release exits.
Rewrite the diagnostic to read the gated entry back and compare it to the source document, or drop it from the handler until it does.
Add a training duration or a barracks queue so the training-tempo card has an effect.
Give building placement the same construction-time model training gets.
Add master-list rows for the two reinforced structures if they are still missing.
Point the notifier header and the release step comment at the centralized secrets folder and drop the two dead ignore entries.
Update or retire the progress tab building-art rows so they match the live pipeline table.

the watchdog now lives outside the registry it watches: X:\Claude\registry-heartbeat.py runs hourly from the native Windows task claude-registry-heartbeat, registered by X:\Claude\register-registry-heartbeat-task.ps1 at 20 past the hour and verified running with LastTaskResult 0 at 00:55 on 2026-09-05. It checks the task-folder count under C:\Users\Kane\.claude\scheduled-tasks, parses the live registry, requires a firing inside 30 hours, and requires the backup chain to be under 48 hours old and to hold a full roster. Failure raises four channels: a Windows toast, X:\Claude\REGISTRY-HEARTBEAT-ALERT.md, CLAUDE-ROUTINES-STOPPED.txt on the desktop, and a line in X:\OPEN-LOOPS.md that the [loops] hook prints at every session start; --test-alert fired all four and the first healthy run withdrew them, restoring OPEN-LOOPS.md byte for byte. routine-health-watch gained a bullet reading registry-heartbeat-state.json, so a dead heartbeat is itself detected. Commit cd1d32d in X:\Claude.
